/**
 * Phase K73 · Feb-2026 — deterministic crew-hue + individual-
 * saturation palette for schedule map pins and calendar events.
 *
 * User adjudication for K73 asked for palette option ``c``:
 *   * Each crew gets its own base HUE.
 *   * Members within a crew are distinguished by SATURATION.
 *   * Solo techs (no crew) get their own hue from the same wheel
 *     at a neutral saturation level.
 *   * The map is deterministic: same ``(crewId, techId)`` always
 *     resolves to the same hex, across sessions and tenants.
 *   * ``display_color_hex`` on the tech record still wins when
 *     set (backward-compat with the pre-K73 admin picker).
 *
 * Colour math
 * -----------
 * A 12-slice HSL wheel gives crews visually distinct hues.
 * Within a crew, saturation cycles across 3 levels (55%, 75%,
 * 95%) — enough to differentiate individuals without breaking
 * the crew grouping. Lightness is fixed at 45% so pins stay
 * legible against the Google Maps light theme.
 *
 * Public surface: ``crewHuedColor({techId, crewId})`` +
 * ``crewHuedColorFromDisplayHex(tech, crewId)`` +
 * ``groupByCrewForLegend(techs, crewMap)``.
 */// 12 hues around the wheel — offsets picked so adjacent crews
// never sit within 25° of each other (readability guardrail).
const CREW_HUES=[200,30,340,90,265,175,55,315,130,285,5,220];const SAT_LEVELS=[55,75,95];const LIGHTNESS=45;const SOLO_SATURATION=68;// Small deterministic 32-bit hash — matches the shape of the
// pre-K73 ``hashedTechColor`` so we don't introduce a new hash
// dependency and stay easy to reason about in tests.
function _hash(seed){if(!seed)return 0;const s=String(seed);let h=0;for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++){h=(h<<5)-h+s.charCodeAt(i);h|=0;}return Math.abs(h);}function _hslToHex(h,s,l){// Standard HSL → RGB → HEX. Everything is integer-clean.
const S=s/100,L=l/100;const C=(1-Math.abs(2*L-1))*S;const H=(h%360+360)%360;const X=C*(1-Math.abs(H/60%2-1));const m=L-C/2;let r=0,g=0,b=0;if(H<60){r=C;g=X;b=0;}else if(H<120){r=X;g=C;b=0;}else if(H<180){r=0;g=C;b=X;}else if(H<240){r=0;g=X;b=C;}else if(H<300){r=X;g=0;b=C;}else{r=C;g=0;b=X;}const toByte=v=>Math.round((v+m)*255).toString(16).padStart(2,"0").toUpperCase();return"#".concat(toByte(r)).concat(toByte(g)).concat(toByte(b));}/**
 * Deterministic hex for ``(techId, crewId)`` under the K73
 * palette. Solo techs (no ``crewId``) get a hue from the same
 * wheel but a fixed neutral saturation so they read as a
 * separate "Solo" band in the legend.
 */export function crewHuedColor(){let _ref=arguments.length>0&&arguments[0]!==undefined?arguments[0]:{},techId=_ref.techId,crewId=_ref.crewId;if(!techId)return"#94A3B8";// slate-400 · matches ScheduleMap unassigned fallback
if(crewId){const hue=CREW_HUES[_hash(crewId)%CREW_HUES.length];const sat=SAT_LEVELS[_hash(techId)%SAT_LEVELS.length];return _hslToHex(hue,sat,LIGHTNESS);}// Solo tech: hash the tech id into the same wheel, fixed sat.
const hue=CREW_HUES[_hash(techId)%CREW_HUES.length];return _hslToHex(hue,SOLO_SATURATION,LIGHTNESS);}/**
 * Convenience wrapper — falls back to ``tech.display_color_hex``
 * if the admin has explicitly pinned a colour for this tech.
 *
 * Passing an explicit color preserves the K51 admin picker and
 * matches the pre-K73 ``hashedTechColor`` fallback chain.
 */export function crewHuedColorFromTech(tech,crewId){if(!tech)return"#94A3B8";if(tech.display_color_hex)return tech.display_color_hex;const id=tech.id||tech.user_id;return crewHuedColor({techId:id,crewId});}/**
 * Given ``techs`` (list) and ``crews`` (list with ``id`` +
 * ``name`` + ``tech_ids``), return a shape suitable for
 * rendering the schedule map legend:
 *
 *     [
 *       { crewId, crewName, techs: [{id, name, colorHex, isExplicit}] },
 *       …
 *       { crewId: null, crewName: "Solo", techs: [...] },
 *     ]
 *
 * Explicit admin-picked colours are surfaced via ``isExplicit``
 * so the legend can render a small "pinned" glyph next to them.
 */export function groupByCrewForLegend(){let techs=arguments.length>0&&arguments[0]!==undefined?arguments[0]:[];let crews=arguments.length>1&&arguments[1]!==undefined?arguments[1]:[];const techById=new Map();for(const t of techs){const id=t.id||t.user_id;if(!id)continue;techById.set(id,t);}const groups=[];const seen=new Set();for(const c of crews){const rows=[];for(const tid of c.tech_ids||[]){const t=techById.get(tid);if(!t)continue;rows.push({id:tid,name:t.name||t.display_name||tid.slice(0,8),colorHex:crewHuedColorFromTech(t,c.id),isExplicit:!!t.display_color_hex});seen.add(tid);}if(rows.length){groups.push({crewId:c.id,crewName:c.name||"Crew",techs:rows});}}const solo=[];for(const t of techs){const id=t.id||t.user_id;if(!id||seen.has(id))continue;solo.push({id,name:t.name||t.display_name||id.slice(0,8),colorHex:crewHuedColorFromTech(t,null),isExplicit:!!t.display_color_hex});}if(solo.length){groups.push({crewId:null,crewName:"Solo",techs:solo});}return groups;}// Named export bundle so callers can ``import { … } from "@/lib/crewPalette"``.
export default{crewHuedColor,crewHuedColorFromTech,groupByCrewForLegend};
